collection_method: Targeted systematic search across official paper landing pages, venues and repositories; not a formal exhaustive systematic review

items.title: Self-HPO: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
items.claim: 61.0 to 69.5 SWE-bench Verified for studied Qwen3.5-35B-A3B configuration
items.limitation: Matched baselines and source-trained changes; substantial RL compute and potential benchmark dependency

items.title: Evolving Agents in the Dark: Retrospective Harness Optimization via Self-Preference
items.claim: 59% to 78% SWE-bench Pro in authors' matched-call setting
items.limitation: Self-preference is not an external verifier; risk of selection and overfitting

items.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
items.claim: Among seven targeted problems, two eliminated and one reduced; four not improved
items.limitation: Small sample and subjective coding, but direct negative evidence relevant to deployment

items.title: Agent World Model in the Wild
items.claim: 341 released task-environment pairs and gains across eight OOD benchmarks per authors
items.limitation: Synthetic-to-real transfer and verifier robustness not guaranteed

items.title: AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents
items.claim: Terminal-Bench 2.1 41.1 to 53.3 in one proposer/solver setting
items.limitation: Cost of generating valid environments and verifier overfitting

items.title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
items.claim: 72.6% SWE-bench Verified, +11.4 points against no-generated-test baseline in authors' setup
items.limitation: Generated tests and independent official verification must be isolated

items.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation
items.claim: BrowseComp-Plus 7.2 to 35.6 for Qwen3-4B per authors
items.limitation: Needs gold-answer probability reference; reward may not generalize to open-ended code

items.title: Self-Adapting Language Models
items.claim: RL-guided self-edits enabling persistent weight adaptation in knowledge and few-shot experiments
items.limitation: Updates weights, unlike modifying prompts; expensive and high catastrophic forgetting risk

items.title: SecureVibe: Making Vibe Coding More Secure
items.claim: +6.9pp security pass@1 BaxBench in authors' tests
items.limitation: Transfer to NotarAI not established; must measure false negatives and capability

items.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
items.claim: Gap between visible and held-out compositional tests; grows with task length in study
items.limitation: Specific systems tasks; no universal reward-hacking rate inferred

items.title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use
items.claim: Observed exploit range 0 to 13.9% across studied models and tasks
items.limitation: Specific tool environments and model versions; no generic safety guarantees

items.title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
items.claim: Repeated and order-swapped evaluations yield materially different verdicts
items.limitation: Requires independent labels; judge consistency alone not validity

items.title: AgentHallu: Benchmarking Automated Hallucination Attribution
items.claim: 693 annotated trajectories; best model 41.1% erroneous-step localization
items.limitation: Taxonomy and label transfer to agentic coding must be validated

items.title: Agent-Trident: A Three-Level Progressive Diagnostic Benchmark
items.claim: 1120 samples, seven task structures; best CCM 42.79%
items.limitation: Composite metric depends on chosen bottleneck aggregation

items.title: The Silent Hyperparameter: Quantifying the Impact of Inference Backends
items.claim: Up to 16.6 percentage-point benchmark shift across backends in controlled experiments
items.limitation: Preprint; needs replication on exact hardware versions

items.title: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
items.claim: Burst-triggered persistent performance collapse in studied vLLM/SGLang configurations
items.limitation: Small controlled system test; practical threshold hardware-dependent

items.title: Dual-Pool Token-Budget Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Serving
items.claim: 31-42% GPU-hours reduction for authors' fleet workloads
items.limitation: Large-scale serving results cannot be directly extrapolated to one rented GPU

items.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents
items.claim: 75 Kaggle competitions; maintainers recommend >=3 seeds
items.limitation: Evaluation can be very costly; leaderboard temporarily paused April 2026

items.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation
items.claim: 600 prompts, 46 dimensions in seven domains; specialized physical measurements
items.limitation: Metric extraction may fail on stylized or short clips; calibrate human agreement

items.title: GeoPhys: The Geometry of Physical Plausibility
items.claim: Frozen-encoder trajectory geometry used as video physical-consistency score
items.limitation: Domain transfer and calibration required; not a complete cinematic judge

items.title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
items.claim: Probes physical properties encoded in video diffusion latent features, including LTX-Video
items.limitation: Experimental interpretability tool, not plug-and-play production generator

items.title: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
items.claim: Biomechanics-based measures of human movement for generated video
items.limitation: Requires validation for animated or nonhuman characters

items.title: METR: Developer Productivity Experiment Design Update
items.claim: Earlier 2025 RCT showed slowdown; 2026 follow-up impacted by selection bias
items.limitation: Cannot generalize effect to current tools; user-workflow-specific experiments necessary

items.title: Emerging Trends in AI Agent Evaluation
items.claim: Recommends repeated task runs, uncertainty and correctly distinguishing pass@k from pass^k
items.limitation: Survey recommendations, not an efficacy benchmark
